name: io.github.Narashiman-K/markdown-notes-mcp
description: Convert PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, EPUB and images to Markdown on your own machine. No upload, no account, no telemetry.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_MCP_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Semicolon-separated folders the server may read. Omit to allow any path.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Enables cloud image recognition, which can also describe charts. Images are sent to Google only when cloud mode is chosen.

environmentVariables.name: ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Enables audio transcription, the only feature that cannot run locally.
